verdict.rationale: A documented public API is a fair question for a SaaS research and notebook product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an API, SDK or programmatic endpoint. The documented features are all UI-driven (uploading sources, chat, public sharing links, exporting to Docs/Sheets, downloads), and these are adjacent features rather than API access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
